api/src/services/worker_pool/__init__.py.name: Worker pool package
api/src/services/worker_pool/__init__.py.description: Brings together the parts that decide how many workers run and how much each can hold.

api/src/services/worker_pool/claims.py.name: Claiming work
api/src/services/worker_pool/claims.py.description: Lets each worker join the pool, take the oldest work it can handle, and step out gracefully.

api/src/services/worker_pool/controller..name: Capacity controller
api/src/services/worker_pool/controller..description: Starts and stops workers as the queue and free memory change, keeping a small warm minimum.

api/src/services/worker_pool/liveness.py.name: Spotting lost workers
api/src/services/worker_pool/liveness.py.description: Finds workers that have stopped reporting and marks the work they held as over.

api/src/services/worker_pool/maintenance.name: Registry cleanup
api/src/services/worker_pool/maintenance.description: Removes long-finished workers from the records so the list stays accurate.

api/src/services/worker_pool/manifest.py.name: Worker launch settings
api/src/services/worker_pool/manifest.py.description: Describes how to start one more worker with the same identity and memory settings as the controller.

api/src/services/worker_pool/recovery.py.name: Ending lost work
api/src/services/worker_pool/recovery.py.description: Closes out runs a lost worker had started and tells anyone waiting, rather than replaying them.

api/src/services/worker_pool/sizing.py.name: Memory sizing rule
api/src/services/worker_pool/sizing.py.description: Works out how much memory each kind of job needs, so machines are neither too small nor wasteful.

api/src/services/worker_pool/unfit.py.name: Work that cannot fit
api/src/services/worker_pool/unfit.py.description: Fails or blocks work larger than any worker can hold, with a clear message, instead of leaving it waiting forever.
